name: American Wood Design, Inc.
old_description: Award-Winning Commercial Cabinetry & Architectural Millwork Since 1996
about:
American Wood Design, Inc. is a family-owned commercial cabinetry and architectural millwork shop based in Chester, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 1996 by Michael Gilhool Sr., who launched the business above a doctor's office in South Philadelphia after his previous employer closed its display shop. Gilhool bartered the shop's machinery for cabinetry work, and the operation later spent nearly two decades at Naamans Road Business Park before moving to a 16,000-square-foot facility in Chester in 2017.

The shop produces custom cabinets, countertops, reception desks, nurse stations, and a full range of architectural millwork including office front systems, wall paneling, and custom trim. Its equipment includes a computerized beam saw, CNC router, and edgebander driven by dedicated software, allowing both high-volume production runs and the flexibility to handle small projects. Services also cover plastic laminate layups with a 3–5 day turnaround, solid surface and stone countertop fabrication, and ongoing maintenance and repair work.

The company serves commercial contractors, architects, and facility managers across the Greater Philadelphia region. Typical projects span office fit-outs, healthcare environments, and retail spaces, with concrete examples including custom reception desks for corporate lobbies, nurse stations for medical facilities, and wholesale plastic laminate panel layups for trade customers.

The founding mission — to build cabinetry and relationships that last a lifetime — emphasizes on-time, on-budget craftsmanship. Gilhool's original impetus was turning a layoff into an opportunity, and the business continues to stress quick turnaround, competitive pricing on wholesale press jobs, and a willingness to handle service calls and modifications long after installation.
